course.title: Personal Finance, Economic Life & Consumer Decisions
course.advice_boundary: Educational only; not individualized financial, investment, tax, insurance or legal advice.

modules.title: Financial Foundations & Goals
modules.essential: How money decisions connect income, expenses, values and time.

lessons.title: Needs, Wants and Financial Priorities
lessons.focus: Separate essential obligations, discretionary choices and longer-term goals.

lessons.title: Income, Net Pay and Cash Flow
lessons.focus: Distinguish gross income, net income and recurring cash flow.

lessons.title: Short-, Medium- and Long-Term Goals
lessons.focus: Turn broad financial goals into measurable time-bound plans.

modules.title: Budgeting & Spending Systems
modules.essential: How to plan spending without pretending a budget removes uncertainty.

lessons.title: Building a Working Budget
lessons.focus: Match expected income with fixed, variable and irregular expenses.

lessons.title: Tracking, Variance and Adjustment
lessons.focus: Compare planned and actual spending and revise realistically.

lessons.title: Sinking Funds and Irregular Costs
lessons.focus: Plan for periodic expenses that do not appear every month.

modules.title: Banking & Payment Systems
modules.essential: How accounts, payment methods and fees affect daily financial life.

lessons.title: Checking, Savings and Account Features
lessons.focus: Compare account purpose, fees, access and protections.

lessons.title: Cards, Transfers and Digital Payments
lessons.focus: Understand common payment rails and transaction risks.

lessons.title: Statements, Reconciliation and Errors
lessons.focus: Review transactions and respond to discrepancies promptly.

modules.title: Credit & Borrowing
modules.essential: How credit creates both access and obligations.

lessons.title: Credit Reports and Credit Scores
lessons.focus: Understand what credit records represent and their limits.

lessons.title: Interest, APR and Borrowing Cost
lessons.focus: Compare loans using rates, fees, term and total cost.

lessons.title: Responsible Credit Use and Warning Signs
lessons.focus: Recognize overextension, minimum-payment traps and predatory terms.

modules.title: Debt Strategy & Consumer Protection
modules.essential: How to evaluate debt obligations and protect against abusive practices.

lessons.title: Debt Inventory and Prioritization
lessons.focus: List balances, rates, payments, consequences and options.

lessons.title: Collections, Rights and Documentation
lessons.focus: Keep records and use official consumer-protection information when disputes arise.

lessons.title: Debt Relief Claims and Scams
lessons.focus: Recognize promises or fees that warrant skepticism or professional review.

modules.title: Taxes & Public Finance Basics
modules.essential: How taxes affect take-home pay, records and civic obligations.

lessons.title: Income Taxes and Withholding
lessons.focus: Understand broad withholding, filing and recordkeeping concepts.

lessons.title: Payroll, Sales and Property Taxes
lessons.focus: Recognize common tax types without giving individualized tax advice.

lessons.title: Records, Deadlines and Professional Help
lessons.focus: Maintain documents and know when a qualified tax professional may be appropriate.

modules.title: Insurance & Risk Management
modules.essential: How insurance transfers some financial risk while leaving exclusions and costs.

lessons.title: Risk, Premiums and Deductibles
lessons.focus: Understand the basic structure of insurance cost sharing.

lessons.title: Health, Auto, Renters/Home and Life Coverage
lessons.focus: Compare broad coverage purposes without recommending specific products.

lessons.title: Exclusions, Limits and Claims
lessons.focus: Read key terms and document losses before relying on assumptions about coverage.

modules.title: Saving & Emergency Reserves
modules.essential: How savings create flexibility and resilience.

lessons.title: Emergency Funds and Liquidity
lessons.focus: Match accessible reserves to realistic risks and obligations.

lessons.title: Interest and Compound Growth
lessons.focus: Understand how time and compounding affect savings.

lessons.title: Automation and Behavioral Design
lessons.focus: Use simple systems that reduce reliance on memory and willpower.

modules.title: Investing Foundations
modules.essential: How investing differs from saving, speculation and guaranteed returns.

lessons.title: Risk, Return and Time Horizon
lessons.focus: Connect investment risk to time, goals and uncertainty.

lessons.title: Diversification and Concentration Risk
lessons.focus: Understand why spreading exposure can reduce specific risk.

lessons.title: Fees, Fraud and Investment Claims
lessons.focus: Evaluate fees, conflicts, guarantees and unrealistic return promises.

modules.title: Housing, Transportation & Major Purchases
modules.essential: How large recurring decisions shape financial capacity.

lessons.title: Renting, Owning and Total Cost
lessons.focus: Compare more than monthly payment when evaluating housing.

lessons.title: Transportation Cost of Ownership
lessons.focus: Include insurance, fuel, maintenance, depreciation and financing.

lessons.title: Financing Major Purchases
lessons.focus: Compare cash price, financing terms and opportunity cost.

modules.title: Consumer Decisions, Fraud & Identity
modules.essential: How to protect money and personal information in marketplaces.

lessons.title: Comparison Shopping and Total Cost
lessons.focus: Compare price, quality, warranties, recurring charges and return terms.

lessons.title: Fraud, Identity Theft and Account Security
lessons.focus: Recognize suspicious requests and protect credentials and records.

lessons.title: Contracts, Subscriptions and Cancellation Terms
lessons.focus: Read key obligations before agreeing to recurring services or financing.

modules.title: Integrated Personal Finance Plan
modules.essential: How to synthesize cash flow, risk, saving, debt and goals into a realistic plan.

lessons.title: Personal Financial Snapshot
lessons.focus: Summarize income, expenses, assets, debts, risks and goals.

lessons.title: Scenario and Stress Testing
lessons.focus: Test how the plan responds to income loss, emergency costs or changing priorities.

lessons.title: Capstone Financial Plan & Reflection
lessons.focus: Present a non-advisory personal finance plan with assumptions, sources and revision triggers.

assessment.capstone: personal financial plan + scenario stress test + consumer protection checklist
